g.text: Engram table sizing in V4.1-Flash: one module
24 prime-sized bucket ranges laid end to end (3 orders x 8 heads), each just above 16,000,000 rows
384,006,168 rows in module 1 (config: engram_num_embeddings[0]); 384,016,682 in module 2
One row: 256 channels of FP8 (E4M3) + 8 E8M0 scales (one per 32 channels)
The tables are outside the 552B backbone count;
the report says '552B backbone parameters and
